title: fix: keep unknown agent costs out of free pricing
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Treat zero-priced agent listings as unknown run cost until measured usage is available; agents may spend Pollen downstream.
- Keep ordinary free models at ∞ requests/Pollen and preserve measured cost estimates; the existing free filter, badges, and price sorting follow the same catalog flag.
- Add direct catalog-to-display/filter/sort regressions for missing, zero, and positive observations. Validation: 55 targeted tests, Enter typecheck, frontend build, and Biome pass.
- Independent follow-up from #14622; completes the display behavior introduced by #13467. No billing, Tinybird, or API changes.

gist.headline: Free until proven pollen
gist.blurb: The catalog now knows the difference between genuinely free models and agents whose runtime cost has not landed yet. Polli put the mystery-price tags in the sensible basket.
gist.summary: Updated the model catalog so agent listings with a zero price observation are treated as having an unknown run cost until measured usage arrives, while ordinary free models continue to display ∞ requests/Pollen and retain their free filtering, badges, and sorting behavior.
gist.impact: Users browsing models now get accurate free-model badges and price ordering: verified free models remain clearly free, while agents that may spend Pollen downstream are shown as cost-unknown until their usage is measured.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper sorting model seed packets into a clearly labeled “FREE” tray and a small “MEASURING” tray for unknown-cost agent seeds. A cozy retro catalog terminal shows infinity symbols beside verified free flowers, while a gentle measuring gauge watches over the agent sprouts; this represents accurate catalog filtering, badges, and sorting rather than a billing change.
